items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: She never did get out too much with me.

ctx.x: I mean they offered me a hundred dollars a night, free rent. Ain't no food or nothing to buy. And I got that. No cutting corners or changing the situation when I got there. And I did get more nights than what they offered me. Oh, that's good. Yeah. Everybody enjoyed it so well, you know. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Well, did you sing, Ms. Brown? No. No. She had to follow a little love to Henry. I wouldn't even say. Well, see. She never did get out too much with me.
I never, truthfully, I never felt, you know, good enough.
